findings.shot: Actual transcript E098-E102/E116; raw.json debrief and observedFinal
findings.problem: In the pinned source reproduction, Sol completes the same five displayed debrief lines as captured E098-E102. sol_debrief is already true when ac_close emits. At final choose, trust.sol is 3, so the evacuation option remains locked, but its reason still asserts that the player has not stood in front of Sol since the flood.
findings.why: The unmet requirement is trust>=16 in this state. A reason that denies the already completed meeting can send the player back to repeat the wrong prerequisite and hides the reason the conjunction still fails.
findings.fix: Change only the English c.final.choose choice e_evac why and Japanese c.final.choose.why.3 to a statement of both prerequisites without denying the completed meeting. Keep {all:[{flag:"sol_debrief"},{trust:["sol",16]}]}, showLocked, goto and effects identical. Candidate wording is in candidate-text.json. Read the 16 preserved state checks with python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open("sol-evacuation-reason-r1/raw.json")); print([(x["language"],x["debriefDone"],x["trust"],x["unlocked"]) for x in r["table"]])".
findings.hypothesis: Confirmed at the fixed-source CPU boundary: DialogueRunner.goto applies ac_close effects before emitting the localized node, and final choose uses debrief AND trust. The static reason covers only missing debrief. The historical capture itself does not record per-event flags; ordinary-play reproduction of the original run is not claimed.

text.en: Sol would have to run it with you. She needs to hear what happened in the flood, and to know she can rely on you.
text.ja: ソルと二人で回すしかない。水害で何が起きたかを彼女に話し、頼れる相手だと思ってもらう必要がある。
text.interpretation: General conjunction of a flood debrief and sufficient trust; it does not assert the debrief has not already happened.
text.caveat: Hear what happened can suggest missing factual information. The actual debrief is largely Sol speaking and saying she already has the names; the code requires this encounter, not a new factual report.

supplied.booleanAdequacy: As a general statement of both prerequisites, it removes the explicitly false claim that the meeting has not happened and covers the three locked combinations. It is not a per-state missing-prerequisite diagnosis.
supplied.semanticQualification: Hear what happened suggests Sol lacks factual knowledge. Captured E099 says she already has the names, and the debrief is Sol speaking. The predicate requires having this encounter, not delivering new information to her. This is a wording-precision caveat, not a demonstrated new Boolean defect.

text.en: Sol would have to run it with you. You need to have spoken with her since the flood, and she needs to know she can rely on you.
text.ja: ソルと二人で回すしかない。水害のあとに彼女と話していて、頼れる相手だと思ってもらえている必要がある。
text.interpretation: States two prerequisites without claiming either one is currently unmet. Spoken with her maps to sol_debrief and reliance maps to the existing trust predicate.
text.caveat: Still a joint-prerequisite explanation, not a dynamic display of the particular missing predicate; prose quality and real rendered fit are unmeasured.

recommended.reason: Have spoken with her since the flood maps directly to the completed debrief and avoids the factual-report implication. The reliance clause maps to the unchanged trust condition. Both are prerequisites; neither claims the meeting remains undone in the trust-only locked state.
recommended.meaningPreservation: English and Japanese candidate state the same two prerequisites without adding numbers or changing any actual game condition. Their wording has not been tested for rendered length or blind prose quality.
